name: Company Secretary
description: Manage statutory records, registers and compliance (Module 13)

name: CS Associate
description: Create and edit secretarial records; cannot waive obligations or issue certified copies

name: CS Trainee
description: Read secretarial records and draft entries

name: Compliance Reviewer
description: Review and publish statutory content; approve compliance completion

name: Delegated CS Secretarial
description: Projection of an engagement: full secretarial access to a client's entity. Not assigned by hand.

name: Delegated CS Observer
description: Projection of a read-only engagement. Not assigned by hand.

name: Delegated CS Facts
description: Engagement projection: read derived financial facts only. Not assigned by hand.

name: Delegated CS Reports
description: Engagement projection: read financial statements. Not assigned by hand.

name: Delegated CS Ledger
description: Engagement projection: read the general ledger and source documents. Not assigned by hand.

name: Delegated CS Banking
description: Engagement projection: read bank data. Granted only by explicit opt-in. Not assigned by hand.
